scripts.install-app: unset FORCE_COLOR; S=$(sed -n "s/^MAC_SIGNING_IDENTITY=//p" .env 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$S" ]; then export APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY="$S"; fi; tauri build && (pkill -x lines; sleep 1; rm -rf ~/Applications/Lines.app && mv src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Lines.app ~/Applications/ && open ~/Applications/Lines.app)
scripts.install-ios: unset FORCE_COLOR; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; : ${IPHONE:?Set IPHONE in .env}; PATH="$PWD/scripts:$PATH" tauri ios build --target aarch64 --debug && xcrun devicectl device install app --device "$IPHONE" src-tauri/gen/apple/build/arm64/Lines.ipa
scripts.sim: unset FORCE_COLOR; set -a; . ./.env; set +a; S=${SIM:-booted}; tauri ios build --target aarch64-sim --debug && (xcrun simctl boot $S 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl install $S src-tauri/gen/apple/build/arm64-sim/Lines.app && xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process $S com.vladartym.lines)
